clauses.title: Scope
clauses.text: 1. Scope —Specifies the dimensional requirement for rubber sealing rings to be used with cast iron detachable joints conforming to IS : 12987 : 1991* for joining light duty asbestos cement pressure pipes conforming to IS : 9627 1980*

clauses.title: The rubber sealing rings
clauses.text: 2.1 The rubber sealing rings shall conform to the general requirement and type 3 of IS 5382:1985++
